Class ErrorUtils

public inherited sharing class ErrorUtils

Utility class for error logging and management. Provides centralized error handling with support for multiple error types (INFO, WARNING, ERROR, EXCEPTION_ERROR, FAULT). Features include builder pattern for error log creation, database persistence, platform event publishing, and Flow integration via invocable methods.

Group:
    Utilities

Since:
    05/01/2025

Version:
    1.8


Change Log

  • 05/01/2025 - v1.0 - Initial version
  • 05/16/2025 - v1.1 - Added support for ErrorLog wrapper class and related methods
  • 07/12/2025 - v1.2 - Added constructor for initializing error log with provided array of errors
  • 07/20/2025 - v1.3 - Added createErrorLog() method for creating error logs from flows
  • 10/25/2025 - v1.4 - Added publish() method to publish error logs as platform events
  • 11/08/2025 - v1.5 - ErrorType enum now complies with naming conventions. New methods getDatabaseErrorType() and getErrorType() for converting between enum and database string values.
  • 12/20/2025 - v1.6 - Added withAdditionalMessage() method to append additional messages to existing error log.
  • 12/22/2025 - v1.7 - Added define() method to create error log record without persisting it.
  • 03/21/2026 - v1.8 - Added createAuraHandledException() factory method.

@InvocableMethod(description='Creates an error log entry in the ErrorLog__c object.' label='Create Error Log')
public static List<Boolean> createErrorLog(List<ErrorUtils.FlowError> errors)

Creates an error log entry from flows in the ErrorLog__c object. Supports batch creation of multiple error logs with configurable error types and codes.

Parameters:
    errors – List of FlowError objects containing error details (message, module, code, type)

Returns:
    List<Boolean>: Single-element list with true if all errors logged successfully, false otherwise
